title: entry.revise, contract version 2
description: Writes the next revision of one or more variants of an entry and moves each variant's head to it (PRD 5.4, 6.4, 10.3): the entry and, per variant, the variant, the version of it the caller read and every field of the revision, as a revision is a whole snapshot of its variant. A variant at another version is version_conflict, a language's variant is authorized in its locale and the shared variant in every locale, and the revisions go in one changeset. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Core\Entries\Domain\Commands\ReviseVariants, and the generated codec ReviseEntryCodecV2 reads it and writes its canonical JSON: every key, sorted, no whitespace.

variants.description: The new revision of each variant, at least one, each variant once; a variant twice is refused with json_invalid, and a variant the entry's type does not hold with validation_failed.

extension_fields.description: The extension fields, an object of fields by handle for each extender's namespace.

field_handle.description: A field's handle: lowercase snake_case of at most 63 characters without a double underscore, never ext and never starting with cms_.

field_namespace.description: An extender's namespace: 1 to 20 lowercase letters and digits, starting with a letter, never ext.

field_value.description: A field's value: a string, an integer, a boolean, null, a list of values or an object of values by a key of 1 to 255 bytes.

fields.description: The fields by handle, in the input form the type's validator reads: the owner's fields, and each extender's fields under ext by its namespace. A text, a decimal (its canonical string), a date (YYYY-MM-DD) and a date-time (RFC 3339) are strings, an integer is an integer, a boolean a boolean, a list a list and a group an object of its fields. The kernel checks the values against the type's schema when it writes them.

variant.description: A variant of the entry: shared, the variant that holds the fields that do not vary by language, or the language tag of a language's variant, such as da or en-GB.

variant_revision.description: The new revision of one variant.

fields.description: Every field of the new revision: the fields the variant holds.

version.description: The version of the variant the caller read.
The version of an aggregate that the caller read, an integer of 1 or more; the command is version_conflict when the aggregate is at another version when it commits.
